paragraphs.text: todo-ledger for DeepSeek Harness: persistent task state, 12 native tools, and cross-session context
in a repo-local _todo/ directory.
# dsh-todo-ledger
[](https://github.com/haruri03/dsh-todo-ledger/releases) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-todo-l
com/haruri03/dsh-todo-ledger/releases) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-todo-ledger) [](LICENSE)
English | 中文
Repository: https://github.com/haruri03/dsh-todo-ledger

A host-level DSH plugin that turns the todo ledger workflow into a resident prompt section,
a set of
native tools, and context stored inside the repository's `_todo/` directory.

It addresses the failure mode where rules live in a skill or `AGENTS.md`, the model forgets to
read
them, and the task list has to be rewritten every turn:
| Before | This plugin |
| Rules live in `AGENTS.md` / a skill and stop working when the model does not read them | A host-le

vel `systemPrompt.section` is present every step of every session, with no load step to forget |
| T
he system `todo_write` list is overwritten each turn and progress is lost | Authoritative state live

s in the repository's `_todo/` files and survives sessions and compaction |
| Context exists only in
conversation history and disappears after compaction | `todo_checkpoint` / `todo_note` write conclu

sions and next steps into `_todo/context/`, and a snapshot is injected on every prompt assembly |
|
The model has to assemble shell commands itself | 12 native tools with schema validation and readabl
has to assemble shell commands itself | 12 native tools with schema validation and readable errors |

The file format is fully compatible with an external todo CLI: the plugin and the original CLI can
b
oth write the same repository and both can run `doctor` on it.

The ledger scaffold follows the caller's choice: `todo_init` and `todo_add` accept an optional
`lang

uage` (`en` or `zh`), and the plugin writes the chosen form for the files of that ledger. It
default

s to English, so a caller outside a Chinese-speaking locale always gets an English ledger.
[该节后续省略]
## Register before implementation
When a ledger exists, the prompt instructs the agent to reuse a matching task or call `todo_add` for
substantive new work requested by the user before editing deliverables, changing configuration, or
running state-changing commands. Register the requested outcome, not each implementation step. Brief
read-only scope inspection may come first; trivial Q&A; and read-only checks need no task. Unclear
scope calls for clarification, not an invented task. Historical checkpoints and inferred follow-ups
do not authorize new work. Missing ledgers are initialized only when the user asks or confirms.
This is prompt guidance, not a runtime execution block or automatic task-creation mechanism.
## Install (manual)
Choose one:

**Human**: copy this directory to `$HOME/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-todo-ledger`,
then
append this row to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**Agent**: run `plugin_manager install_bundle --target "<path-to-plugin>"`.
### Install from Git

When the repository root is the package (it contains `package.json` and `dsh.bundle`), install it
di
rectly from its Git URL:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The same operation is available to humans through the Web plugin page ("Add plugin") or the CLI:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### Install from npm
The package is published as `dsh-todo-ledger`, so the npm name alone installs it:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Tarball URLs are accepted too. To update, remove and reinstall, or wait for an upstream release.

After installation, every new session carries a `[todo-ledger · cross-session tasks and context]`
pr
ompt section, and the tool list gains:
`todo_context / todo_list / todo_add / todo_show / todo_status / todo_complete / todo_archive / todo
_note / todo_checkpoint / todo_snapshot / todo_doctor / todo_init`
No restart is required.
## Layout
Inside the repository root (the directory that contains `_todo/`; a repository that already keeps `t
odo/` keeps working, the plugin accepts either name):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

States are `todo` / `doing` / `blocked` / `review`; there is no `done`. `review` means work is
finis

hed and waiting for the owner's sign-off. Closing a task requires both `evidence` and
`signoff` (the

owner's own words); neither may be omitted. This is a hard rule of the todo ledger
workflow.
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The prompt section is assembled from the ledger, not stored in it: every prompt gets a fresh
snapsho
t, so a stale session cannot revive a stale task list.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

There is no `done`. A predecessor in `review` does not unblock a dependent — only `todo_complete`
do

re is no `done`. A predecessor in `review` does not unblock a dependent — only `todo_complete`
does.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The same four actions exist as `todo-context` subcommands. Nothing returns the whole log by
accident
: the index is bounded, and a full entry needs its ref.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Tools
| Tool | Purpose |

| `todo_list` | List tasks and states (optionally filtered); call it before starting work |
| `todo_

show` | Show one task's details |
| `todo_add` | Create a task (unique kebab-case slug) |
| `todo_st

atus` | Change state and sync the task frontmatter, index, and queue |
| `todo_complete` | Close and

archive a task; requires `evidence` + `signoff` |
| `todo_archive` | Abandon a task; additionally r

equires `reason` |
| `todo_note` | Append to `context/log.md`; with `slug`, insert at the end of tha
t task's `## Progress` section (the placeholder is removed on first write); with `state`, advance th

e state machine in the same call |
| `todo_checkpoint` | Overwrite `context/now.md`: current goal /

next step / key files |
| `todo_snapshot` | Read-only: return the snapshot that would be injected in

to the prompt (check whether the ledger is stale) |
| `todo_context` | Bounded reads for progressive
disclosure: `overview` first, then `logs` (summaries with stable refs and a cursor), `log` (one ent

ry in full), `task`, or `checkpoint` |
| `todo_doctor` | Two-way consistency check; returns errors a

nd warnings |
